LocalAdapter.Origin: Locally authored bounded/cancellable adapter over the managed SDK API; control parameters follow upstream JitsiSilkEncoder.cs.

LocalAdapter.PartialFinalFrame: Padded with zeros; never silently discarded.
LocalAdapter.MinimumTwoPackets: Caller pads input to at least two packets.
LocalAdapter.TemporaryBuffers: Input short array, packet byte array, packet-length array, length prefix and one bounded output buffer cleared in finally; DSP state is managed and not guaranteed zeroed.
